newsitem.title: GERMANY: Welteke-Amsterdam deal shows sides will compromise.
newsitem.headline: Welteke-Amsterdam deal shows sides will compromise.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke said on Tuesday that the agreeement reached on the stability pact for currency union at the Amsterdam summit showed compromise was possible from all sides.

"It shows that all sides are willing to compromise," said Welteke and he added that with the stability pact finished, he hoped that European Union countries would be able to tackle the problem of unemployment.

EU leaders reached an agreement on a pact to enforce budget discipline after the new currency is launched, which included measures aimed at promoting employment and growth to accommodate demands from France's new Socialist-led government.
Welteke was speaking to reporters before a meeting at the German Chamber of Commerce in Frankfurt.
